faqs.q: Does travel apply once for the stay?
faqs.a: Travel is included in every accepted Uluwatu visit. There is no separate guest travel fee for a single session or pack visit.

faqs.q: What is the main difference between mobility coaching and private strength training?
faqs.a: Mobility coaching centres on controlled range and non-clinical stretching. Private Strength Training centres on a coached strength and fitness workout.

faqs.q: Can either service treat an injury?
faqs.a: No. Both are fitness services. Diagnosis, injury treatment and rehabilitation require an appropriate clinical professional.

faqs.q: Can I include both services in a programme?
faqs.a: They can be scheduled as separate named visits when the dates, professionals, location and complete written quote are confirmed.

title: How to prepare for a bodywork and recovery session at your villa
description: Prepare a Bali villa or Jakarta home for bodywork and recovery: room, clothing, consent, access, price, scope and a clear booking checklist.
primaryQuery: how to prepare for a bodywork and recovery session at your villa

faqs.q: What should I wear for a bodywork and recovery session at my villa?
faqs.a: Wear normal, comfortable exercise clothing that allows sitting, lying down and gentle movement. You remain appropriately clothed throughout the session.

faqs.q: Is bodywork and recovery a medical or physiotherapy service?
faqs.a: No. It is a non-clinical wellness session with assisted stretching, light myofascial release and relaxation. It does not diagnose, treat or rehabilitate an injury.

faqs.q: How much is a 60-minute bodywork and recovery session?
faqs.a: The guide price is Rp 1.300.000 for one adult in Bali or Jakarta. A second adult adds Rp 250.000. The written quote confirms the accepted address, professional and complete total.
